newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIAN BIRZHU 5-MO NET PROFIT 1.9 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIAN BIRZHU 5-MO NET PROFIT 1.9 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuanian official list company Birzhu Milk said on Tuesday that its net profit rose to 1.9 million litas in the first five months of the year compared to 897,000 litas in the same period of 1996.
The director general of the company Vladas Songaila also told Reuters that its net profit in May rose to 635,000 litas from 150,000 litas in April.
"We are a little bit dissapointed since we were expecting a higher net profit last month," Songaila said.
He added that the company was still targeting a 13 million litas net profit for 1997 and was connecting its hopes with the new production lines which are to be installed by the end of the month.
"The new production lines should start operating before the end of the month and the new products should appear on July 1," Songaila said, but declined to say what the product will be.
He said that the equipment was on its way and it would take some 10 days to assemble.
The company reported earlier this month that its sales in the first five months of the year reached 43.6 million litas.
It also said that it had around 12 percent of the local milk products market last month.
The company's audited net profit for 1996 was 2.02 million litas.
